content:
Ready for a full Class 3 Maths Olympiad rehearsal? A real IMO or SOF paper mixes every chapter — numbers, the four operations, fractions, money, measurement, time, geometry and data handling — in one 30-question set. This free test gives a 10-question taste, and the practice-papers e-book gives you 25 complete Maths Olympiad Class 3 sample papers with answers.

What a Class 3 IMO sample paper looks like

  • 30 questions in one paper, balanced across all 10 chapters
  • A mix of number work, operations, fractions, money, measurement, time, geometry and data
  • An answer key and step-by-step solution for every question
  • Graded intermediate to hard, just like the real SOF Olympiad

How to use Class 3 Olympiad practice papers

  • Sit one paper in a quiet 30–40 minute slot, no help
  • Mark it with the answer key, then read the solution for every wrong one
  • Note which chapter the mistakes cluster in and revise that chapter
  • Repeat weekly — steady practice beats last-minute cramming

Take the free mixed test

The 10 questions below are pulled from across the syllabus. The full 25 Practice Papers e-book has 750 questions — 25 papers of 30 — each fully solved: the best Maths Olympiad class 3 question papers PDF for exam practice.

Learn the syllabus first with the free IMO Maths Olympiad course at vidaara.org.

questions.q: Find the difference between the place value and the face value of 8 in 5,842.
questions.explanation: Place value of 8 = 800, face value = 8. Difference = 800 − 8 = 792.

questions.q: Kiran has 480 paise saved in a piggy bank. How much money is that in rupees?
A cricket match starts at 10:30 am and runs for 3 h 15 min. At what time does it end?
I am a solid with no flat face and no edge; I am curved all over. Who am I?
questions.explanation: Only a sphere is curved everywhere with no flat face and no edge.

questions.q: If 1 picture = 2 chocolates, how many pictures are needed to show 24 chocolates?
